sections.Profile:
Extra Inning is a 1971 electro-mechanical pinball machine from D. Gottlieb & Co., designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
